Reserved Park Visit Date: October 4, 2025
Ticket 2 of 4
⚫ This Offer Package contains four 1-Day Tickets. Offer Tickets
purchased under the same Package must be used together
for Park admission. Offer Tickets and e-Vouchers not used
within the validity period or together with other Offer Tickets
purchased under the same Package and any e-Voucher not
used, will be void without exchange, refund or compensation.
⚫ ONLY One (1) designated General Admission Ticket in a
"Group of 4" Package includes one (1) e-Voucher to receive
two designated bottled drinks for free on the purchase of two
designated bottled drinks in a single transaction at a
designated outdoor vending cart in the Park; No e-Vouchers
will be issued for other General Admission Ticket(s) and
Child/ Senior Offer Ticket(s) in the package.
All Tourists visiting Hong Kong who are not holders of
Hong Kong Identity Cards are eligible to benefit from this
package, guests must present his/her valid travel document
with photo identification when using the offer.
Guests are required to have reservation with valid tickets
before visiting the Park. Park visit reservations is made for
the date selected at the time of purchase. Guests may
change the reservations with valid tickets prior to arrival via
"Link Reservation from eTicket" by cancelling and making
another reservation. Park visit reservation of each type of
ticket is subject to a limited quota.
Please present your full page Disney eTicket on your mobile
device, or have your printed full page eTicket ready to present
at the Main Entrance Turnstiles. Incomplete e-ticket will not
be accepted. E-tickets will void if altered or tampered with.
• Terms and Conditions apply to this Offer. Please visit Hong
Kong Disneyland Website for details.
1-Day Ticket is valid for one visit to the Park on any date specified
for the above Tier or any lower ticket tier on or before December
15,2025.
